title: Refactoring Techniques
description: The refactoring catalog from refactoring.guru, one line each. Follow the links for step-by-step mechanics and examples.

entries.title: Extract Method
entries.summary: Move a fragment of code into its own well-named method.

entries.title: Inline Method
entries.summary: Replace calls to a trivial method with its body, then delete it.

entries.title: Extract Variable
entries.summary: Put a complex expression's result in a variable whose name explains it.

entries.title: Inline Temp
entries.summary: Replace a temporary variable that holds a simple expression with the expression itself.

entries.title: Replace Temp with Query
entries.summary: Move an expression stored in a temp into a method and call it instead.

links.label: Replace Temp with Query on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Split Temporary Variable
entries.summary: Use separate variables when one temp is reused for different values.

entries.title: Remove Assignments to Parameters
entries.summary: Assign to a local variable instead of reassigning a parameter.

links.label: Remove Assignments to Parameters on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Method with Method Object
entries.summary: Turn a long method with tangled locals into its own class so you can split it.

links.label: Replace Method with Method Object on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Substitute Algorithm
entries.summary: Replace an algorithm with a clearer or simpler one that gives the same result.

entries.title: Move Method
entries.summary: Move a method to the class that uses it most.

entries.title: Move Field
entries.summary: Move a field to the class that uses it most.

entries.title: Extract Class
entries.summary: Split part of a class's responsibilities into a new class.

entries.title: Inline Class
entries.summary: Fold a class that does too little into another class.

entries.title: Hide Delegate
entries.summary: Add a method on the server that hides the delegate, so clients don't chain through it.

entries.title: Remove Middle Man
entries.summary: Let clients call the delegate directly when a class only forwards calls.

entries.title: Introduce Foreign Method
entries.summary: Add a helper in the client (taking the library object as an argument) for a missing library method.

entries.title: Introduce Local Extension
entries.summary: Create a subclass or wrapper of a library class that adds the methods you need.

entries.title: Change Value to Reference
entries.summary: Replace many identical value copies with a single shared reference object.

links.label: Change Value to Reference on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Change Reference to Value
entries.summary: Turn a small, rarely-changed reference object into an immutable value object.

links.label: Change Reference to Value on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Duplicate Observed Data
entries.summary: Separate domain data from UI classes and keep them in sync via observers.

entries.title: Self Encapsulate Field
entries.summary: Access a field through getters/setters even inside its own class.

entries.title: Replace Data Value with Object
entries.summary: Turn a primitive field with behaviour into its own object.

links.label: Replace Data Value with Object on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Array with Object
entries.summary: Replace an array holding different kinds of data with an object with named fields.

links.label: Replace Array with Object on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Change Unidirectional Association to Bidirectional
entries.summary: Add a back-reference when both classes need to navigate to each other.

links.label: Change Unidirectional Association to Bidirectional on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Change Bidirectional Association to Unidirectional
entries.summary: Remove a back-reference that one side no longer needs.

links.label: Change Bidirectional Association to Unidirectional on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Encapsulate Field
entries.summary: Make a public field private and add accessors.

entries.title: Encapsulate Collection
entries.summary: Return a read-only view of a collection and add add/remove methods.

entries.title: Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant
entries.summary: Name unexplained literals with a constant.

links.label: Replace Magic Number with Symbolic Constant on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Type Code with Class
entries.summary: Replace a type-code primitive with a class (or enum) so values are type-checked.

links.label: Replace Type Code with Class on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Type Code with Subclasses
entries.summary: Use subclasses when a type code changes behaviour.

links.label: Replace Type Code with Subclasses on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Type Code with State/Strategy
entries.summary: Use state/strategy objects when the type code can change at runtime.

links.label: Replace Type Code with State/Strategy on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Subclass with Fields
entries.summary: Collapse subclasses that only differ in constant-returning methods into fields.

links.label: Replace Subclass with Fields on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Consolidate Conditional Expression
entries.summary: Combine several conditions that lead to the same result into one well-named check.

entries.title: Consolidate Duplicate Conditional Fragments
entries.summary: Move code duplicated in every branch outside the conditional.

links.label: Consolidate Duplicate Conditional Fragments on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Decompose Conditional
entries.summary: Extract a complicated condition and its branches into well-named methods.

entries.title: Replace Conditional with Polymorphism
entries.summary: Move each branch of a type-based conditional into an overriding method.

links.label: Replace Conditional with Polymorphism on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Remove Control Flag
entries.summary: Use break/continue/return instead of a boolean variable that controls a loop.

entries.title: Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses
entries.summary: Handle special cases early and return, flattening the happy path.

links.label: Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Introduce Null Object
entries.summary: Return an object with do-nothing behaviour instead of null to remove null checks.

entries.title: Introduce Assertion
entries.summary: Make an assumption explicit with an assertion.

entries.title: Add Parameter
entries.summary: Give a method the extra data it needs as a parameter.

entries.title: Remove Parameter
entries.summary: Delete a parameter the method no longer uses.

entries.title: Rename Method
entries.summary: Rename a method so its name says what it does.

entries.title: Separate Query from Modifier
entries.summary: Split a method that both returns a value and changes state into two.

links.label: Separate Query from Modifier on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Parameterize Method
entries.summary: Merge similar methods that differ only by a value into one method with a parameter.

entries.title: Introduce Parameter Object
entries.summary: Replace a recurring group of parameters with one object.

entries.title: Preserve Whole Object
entries.summary: Pass the whole object instead of several values pulled from it.

entries.title: Remove Setting Method
entries.summary: Remove a setter for a field that should only be set at creation.

entries.title: Replace Parameter with Explicit Methods
entries.summary: Split a method that switches on a parameter into one method per case.

links.label: Replace Parameter with Explicit Methods on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Parameter with Method Call
entries.summary: Let the method obtain a value itself instead of receiving it as a parameter.

links.label: Replace Parameter with Method Call on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Hide Method
entries.summary: Make a method private (or protected) when nothing outside uses it.

entries.title: Replace Constructor with Factory Method
entries.summary: Use a static/named factory when construction needs more than a plain constructor.

links.label: Replace Constructor with Factory Method on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Error Code with Exception
entries.summary: Throw an exception instead of returning a special error value.

links.label: Replace Error Code with Exception on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Exception with Test
entries.summary: Check a condition up front instead of relying on catching an exception.

links.label: Replace Exception with Test on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Pull Up Field
entries.summary: Move a field shared by subclasses into the superclass.

entries.title: Pull Up Method
entries.summary: Move identical subclass methods into the superclass.

entries.title: Pull Up Constructor Body
entries.summary: Move shared constructor code into the superclass constructor.

links.label: Pull Up Constructor Body on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Push Down Field
entries.summary: Move a field used by only some subclasses down into them.

entries.title: Push Down Method
entries.summary: Move a method used by only some subclasses down into them.

entries.title: Extract Subclass
entries.summary: Create a subclass for features used only in some instances.

entries.title: Extract Superclass
entries.summary: Move common features of two classes into a new parent class.

entries.title: Extract Interface
entries.summary: Pull a shared subset of methods into an interface.

entries.title: Collapse Hierarchy
entries.summary: Merge a subclass into its parent when they're practically the same.

entries.title: Form Template Method
entries.summary: Turn similar algorithms in subclasses into a template method in the parent.

entries.title: Replace Inheritance with Delegation
entries.summary: Hold the former parent in a field and delegate, instead of inheriting from it.

links.label: Replace Inheritance with Delegation on refactoring.guru

entries.title: Replace Delegation with Inheritance
entries.summary: Inherit when a class delegates nearly everything to another.

links.label: Replace Delegation with Inheritance on refactoring.guru
